about: A revive that put us back at the boss (is_revived, upstream's overworld revive) is not the end of the run: the overlay's combat_once swallows it (ark_overrides.tasks.py combat_once) and do_run's `if self.is_revived: continue` (FarmEchoTask.py:184-185) takes the next lap where we stand. Red at 034a555d~1 (86bc0960, OK-WW v3.7.3): it swallowed only its own in-place realm revive, so this one went up to do_run, which with no teleport re-raises it and the run ends. Constructed: no pulled log has a revive in an echo farm, and the relay's echo farm always teleports (Boss Challenge); this is upstream's 'Teleport to Boss: No' use.
